D1:183: Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease. A steatotic liver disease characterized by at least one of five specified cardiometabolic risk factors and no other discernible cause with normal to no alcohol use. The five cardiometabolic risk factors are: (1) higher than normal body mass index or waist circumference; (2) higher than normal serum glucose or glycated hemoglobin level, or type 2 diabetes; (3) higher than normal blood pressure or hypertensive treatment; (4) higher than normal plasma triglycerides or lipid lowering treatment; and (5) lower than normal plasma high-density lipoprotein cholesterol. Synonyms: MAFLD; MASLD; metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease; metabolic dysfunction-related steatotic liver disease; metabolic-associated fatty liver disease.
D1:184: Chordoma. A notochordal cancer that derives_from cellular remnants of the notochord. Synonyms: notochordoma.
D1:187: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis. A frontotemporal dementia and/or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in CHMP2B on 3p11.2. Synonyms: ALS17; AMYOTROPHIC LATERAL SCLEROSIS 17 (FORMERLY); amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 17; CHMP2B-RELATED; CHMP2B-related frontotemporal dementia.
D1:190: Sarcoma, Endometrial Stromal. An endometrial stromal tumor that has_material_basis_in connective tissue. Synonyms: endometrial stromal sarcoma, high grade; ESS; Undifferentiated endometrial sarcoma.
D1:192: Fibroma. A connective tissue benign neoplasm composed of fibrous or connective tissues that derives_from mesenchymal tissue.
D1:193: Fibrosarcoma. A connective tissue cancer that has_material_basis_in fibrous connective tissue and characterized by the presence of immature proliferating fibroblasts or undifferentiated anaplastic spindle cells in a storiform pattern. Synonyms: Fibrocytic tumor; fibrosarcoma of soft tissue; fibrous tissue neoplasm.
D1:195: Hemangioma. A cardiovascular organ benign neoplasm that has_material_basis_in endothelial cells that line blood vessels and is characterized by increased number of normal or abnormal vessels filled with blood.
D1:198: Klatskin Tumor. An intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma arising near or at the confluence of the right and left hepatic ducts. Synonyms: hilar cholangiocarcinoma; hilar cholangiocellular carcinoma; Klatskin tumour; Klatskin's tumour; Perihilar extrahepatic bile duct carcinoma.
D1:201: Vitreoretinopathy, Proliferative. A retinal and vitreous disease characterized by ocular inflammation, vascular dropout, large spots of hyperpigmentation, neovascularization of the peripheral and posterior retina, vitreous hemorrhage, and retinal detachment that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the CAPN5 gene on chromosome 11q13.5. Synonyms: ADNIV; autosomal dominant neovascular inflammatory vitreoretinopathy; proliferative vitreoretinopathy; Retinitis proliferans.
D1:202: Retinal Degeneration. A retinal disease that is characterized by deterioration of the retina caused by the progressive and eventual death of the cells of the retina. Synonyms: degeneration of retina.
D1:203: Lupus Erythematosus, Systemic. A lupus erythematosus that is an inflammation of connective tissue marked by skin rashes, joint pain and swelling, inflammation of the kidneys and inflammation of the tissue surrounding the heart. Synonyms: disseminated lupus erythematosus; SLE - Lupus Erythematosus, systemic.
D1:204: Uterine Neoplasms. A female reproductive organ cancer that is located_in the uterus. Synonyms: CA - cancer of uterus; malignant neoplasm of uterus; malignant uterine tumor; neoplasm of uterus; Tumour of uterus.
D1:205: Heroin Dependence. An opiate dependence that involves the continued use of heroin despite problems related to use of the substance.
D1:207: Myelodysplastic Syndromes. A bone marrow cancer that is characterized by under production of white blood cells, red blood cells and platelets.
D1:208: Carcinoma, Islet Cell. An islet cell tumor that has_material_basis_in epithelial cells. Synonyms: carcinoma of endocrine pancreas; Islet cell carcinoma; malignant neoplasm of islets of Langerhans; pancreatic neuroendocrine carcinoma.
D1:209: Purpura, Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic. Synonyms: Moschcowitz's syndrome.
D1:210: Diabetic Retinopathy. Synonyms: Retinal abnormality - diabetes-related.
D1:211: Substance-Related Disorders. A disease of mental health involving the abuse or dependence on a substance that is ingested in order to produce a high, alter one's senses, or otherwise affect functioning.
D1:212: Burkitt Lymphoma. A mature B-cell neoplasm of B-cells found in the germinal center. Synonyms: Burkitt lymphoma/leukaemia; Burkitt's Lymphoma; Burkitt's tumor; Burkitt's tumor or lymphoma; malignant lymphoma, Burkitt's type.
D1:214: Leukemia, Myeloid. A leukemia that is located_in myeloid tissue. Synonyms: leukaemia myelogenous; leukemia myelogenous; myeloid granulocytic leukaemia; myeloid granulocytic leukemia; myeloid leukaemia.
D1:215: Myopia. A refractive error characterized by the inability to see farther objects clearly. Synonyms: near vision; near-sightedness; short-sightedness.
D1:216: Syndrome. A disease characterized by a group of signs and symptoms that occur together and characterize a particular abnormality.
D1:217: Rhabdomyosarcoma. A skeletal muscle cancer that arise from skeletal muscle progenitors.
D1:219: Frontotemporal Dementia. A frontotemporal dementia and/or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in CHMP2B on 3p11.2. Synonyms: ALS17; AMYOTROPHIC LATERAL SCLEROSIS; AMYOTROPHIC LATERAL SCLEROSIS 17 (FORMERLY); amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 17; CHMP2B-RELATED.
D1:220: Kidney Diseases. A urinary system disease that is located_in the kidney. Synonyms: impaired renal function disease; nephropathy.
D1:221: Multiple Sclerosis, Relapsing-Remitting. A multiple sclerosis that is characterized by relapse (attacks of symptom flare-ups) followed by remission (periods of recovery). Symptoms may vary from mild to severe, and relapses and remissions may last for days or months. More than 80 percent of people who have MS begin with relapsing-remitting cycles. Synonyms: Relapsing-remitting MS; RRMS.
D1:225: Angelman Syndrome. A syndrome that is characterized by delayed development, intellectual disability, severe speech impairment, and problems with movement and balance. Synonyms: happy puppet syndrome; puppetlike syndrome.
D1:226: Down Syndrome. A chromosomal duplication syndrome that is characterized by flat-looking facial features and weak muscle tone (hypotonia) in infancy and is caused by trisomy of all or a critical portion of chromosome 21 and is associated with intellectual disability. Synonyms: Complete trisomy 21 syndrome; Down's syndrome; Down's syndrome - trisomy 21; Downs syndrome; G Trisomy.
D1:227: Sarcoma, Kaposi. A connective tissue cancer that derives_from lymphatic endothelium, and derives_from spindle cells, results_in_formation_of vascular channels that fill with blood cells, has_material_basis_in Human herpesvirus 8 (Rhadinovirus humangamma8). Synonyms: African lymphadenopathic Kaposi's sarcoma; anal Kaposi's sarcoma; cardiac Kaposi's sarcoma; central nervous system Kaposi's sarcoma; conjunctival Kaposi's sarcoma.
D1:229: Narcolepsy. A sleep disorder that involves an excessive urge to sleep at inappropriate times, such as while at work. Synonyms: Narcolepsy, without cataplexy; paroxysmal sleep.
D1:231: Asthma. A bronchial disease that is characterized by chronic inflammation and narrowing of the airways, which is caused by a combination of environmental and genetic factors. The disease has_symptom recurring periods of wheezing (a whistling sound while breathing), has_symptom chest tightness, has_symptom shortness of breath, has_symptom mucus production and has_symptom coughing. Synonyms: bronchial hyperreactivity; chronic obstructive asthma; chronic obstructive asthma with acute exacerbation; chronic obstructive asthma with status asthmaticus.
D1:232: Cleft Lip. An orofacial cleft that is characterized by a congenital defect in the upper lip where the maxillary prominence fails to merge with the merged medial nasal prominences. Synonyms: cheiloschisis; cleft lip, unilateral, complete; complete unilateral cleft lip; hare lip; Labium leporinum.
D1:233: Plasmacytoma. Synonyms: Myeloma - solitary; Myeloma, solitary; Solitary myeloma; Solitary plasmacytoma.
D1:234: Leishmaniasis. A parasitic protozoa infectious disease that involves infection caused by protozoan parasite of the genus Leishmania, which is transmitted by the bite of sand fly (subfamily Phlebotominae). Synonyms: Post Kala-Azar Dermal Leishmaniasis; post-kala-azar dermal infectious disease by leishmaniasis; Post-kala-azar dermal leishmaniasis.
D1:235: Nasopharyngeal Neoplasms. A pharynx cancer that is located in the nasopharynx, the uppermost region of the pharynx or throat, where the nasal passages and auditory tubes join the remainder of the upper respiratory tract. Synonyms: carcinoma of nasopharynx; malignant Nasopharyngeal tumor; malignant neoplasm of nasopharynx; Nasopharyngeal carcinoma; nasopharynx cancer.
D1:236: Carcinoma, Adenoid Cystic. An adenocarcinoma that is characterized by bands or cylinders of hyalinized or mucinous stroma separating or surrounded by nests or cords of small epithelial cells.
D1:237: Pancreatic Intraductal Neoplasms. A pancreatic cancer that is characterized as a slow-growing epithelial neoplasm with ductal differentiation that arises from the exocrine pancreas and grows mostly within the pancreatic ducts. Synonyms: IPMN.
D1:239: Hodgkin Disease. A lymphoma that is marked by the presence of a type of cell called the Reed-Sternberg cell. Synonyms: HL; Hodgkin lymphoma; Hodgkin's sarcoma; Hodgkins lymphoma; stage I Subdiaphragmatic Hodgkin Lymphoma.
D1:240: Thyroid Carcinoma, Anaplastic. A thyroid gland carcinoma that is composed of undifferentiated cells. Synonyms: thyroid gland anaplastic carcinoma.
D1:241: Rectal Neoplasms. A colorectal cancer that is located_in the rectum. Synonyms: cancer of rectum; carcinoma of rectum; carcinoma of the rectum; malignant neoplasm of rectum; malignant Rectal tumor.
D1:244: Cardiomyopathies. A heart disease and a myopathy that is characterized by deterioration of the function of the heart muscle.
D1:245: Bone Neoplasms. A connective tissue cancer that is located_in bone and is characterized by uncontrolled cellular proliferation that destroys normal bone tissue. Synonyms: bone neoplasm; bone tumour; CA - bone cancer; malignant bone neoplasm; malignant bone tumour.
D1:246: Parathyroid Neoplasms. An endocrine gland cancer located_in the parathyroid glands located in the neck. Synonyms: carcinoma of Parathyroid gland; malignant neoplasm of parathyroid gland; malignant neoplasm of the Parathyroid; malignant tumor of parathyroid gland; neoplasm of parathyroid gland.
D1:247: Bile Duct Neoplasms. A biliary tract cancer that is located_in the bile duct. Synonyms: bile duct tumor; Ca extrahepatic bile ducts; malignant neoplasm of the extrahepatic bile duct.
D1:248: Rhabdomyosarcoma, Embryonal. A rhabdomyosarcoma wherein the mesenchymally-derived malignant cells resemble the primitive developing skeletal muscle of the embryo; it occurs most often in the head and neck area or in the genital or urinary organs.
D1:250: Teratocarcinoma. A mixed germ cell tumor that is a mixture of teratoma with embryonal carcinoma, or with choriocarcinoma, or with both. Synonyms: mixed Embryonal carcinoma and teratoma.
D1:252: Oligodendroglioma. Synonyms: oligodendroglial neoplasm; oligodendroglial tumor.
